Class PluginCallContext

java.lang.Object
com.soulfiremc.server.api.PluginCallContext
public final class PluginCallContext extends Object

Authenticated, permission-checked runtime context for a plugin RPC.

The context is installed before the generated gRPC handler runs and follows asynchronous work through gRPC's context propagation. Plugin handlers can resolve their declared scope without parsing headers or reaching into core authentication internals.
